posts.title: Life Update
posts.description: Hello everyone! I know it’s been a while since I last posted. Whoops, sorry about that! I’ve been so busy working on a new project I didn’t realise until today that although I’ve mentioned it in a few places, I’ve never actually written a proper public post to update you all on what I’ve been doing. So here is a proper all-in-one post to inform you of everything that’s going on over on this side:

posts.title: Brb
posts.description: This post is way overdue. Sorry I haven’t posted in a while, I’ve just been finding it really hard to be creative lately. The short version is I got hit with burnout again. It’s been a bad one. I felt depressed, lost, and I basically ran off into a metaphorical forest to hide for a while. I started questioning everything. Do I still enjoy drawing comics?
